build_HiddenEncoder: build a HiDDeN watermark encoder network with configurable blocks, bits, and channels to embed messages into images
build_HiddenDecoder: build a HiDDeN watermark decoder network to extract embedded messages from watermarked images
build_VitEncoder: build a Vision Transformer based watermark encoder that injects messages into image patches using transformer blocks
build_DvmarkEncoder: build a multi-scale watermark encoder with downsampling and upsampling layers for robust message embedding
build_EncoderDecoder: build a full encoder-attenuation-augmentation-decoder pipeline for training watermark embedding and extraction end to end
